notes.title: Updated to ver.0.0.24.
notes.content:
Updated to ver.0.0.24.　

 ---- Version 0.0.24 Update Details ---- 
Fixed some bugs.

Fixed a bug in the button icon notation.
Fixed a bug that prevented keyboard operation in certain environments.
Fixed the key repeat problem in certain scenes.
Fixed a bug in the screen settings that caused the layout to collapse in certain resolutions.
Fixed other minor bugs.

We hope you will continue to enjoy "Abarenbo Tengu & Zombie Nation".
